create_DirectionalLights: create a DirectionalLights object with ambient, diffuse, and specular color tensors on a CUDA device
create_PointLights: create a PointLights object with diffuse color and location tensors for point-based lighting
test_DirectionalLights_diffuse: test the DirectionalLights diffuse method by computing diffuse lighting from surface normals and light direction
test_PointLights_specular: test the PointLights specular method by computing specular highlights from points, normals, and camera position
test_AmbientLights: test the AmbientLights class by initializing with a batch of ambient color tensors and verifying output
